page.layout: One printed page: an engraved title page. Full-width engraving with a banner at the top, a central title cartouche with the title lines, and an imprint cartouche below. No running text, no margins with text.

main_text.l: Accessit ob vicinitatem, diversorum que Conjugiorum et successionis hæreditariæ quondam unionem,
M. Wernhero Teschenmacher ab Elverfeldt Montano.

page.notes: Engraving with a central horseman figure, putti, flags and coats of arms; the banner at the top carries mottoes, partly illegible. Banner text at top: "...viam ... fier ... sua ... ", not reliably readable. The imprint date reads CIↃIↃXXXVIII, i.e. MDCXXXVIII (1638), set in old numerals. Lines transcribed from the title cartouche as printed; the italic lines and the long s are rendered as plain s. Some letters in "ANNALES" and "GELDRIÆ" are set in mixed type and may differ slightly from the printed form. The head "ANNALES" line and the imprint are copied as seen.
